best_idea: Resolve equipment conflicts with a fixed table (two-hand clears both hands, body armour clears split pieces, a second ear or fin takes the free twin) and validate a whole bank batch before moving any row.
decision_why: Keep the conflict table and twin placement with Frankendom slot names; make the bank batch all-or-nothing in one transaction; do not copy the write-behind persistence because the server must commit before the client sees a change.
acceptance: A server test equips a two-hand weapon while a shield is worn: the shield comes off, the two-hand item sits in the dual slot, and a bank deposit of [valid line, invalid line] changes nothing and returns one refusal.
